originalTitle: US stocks today: Nasdaq falls at open as DeepSeek's AI chip push rattles markets
simplifiedContent: The Nasdaq, a major US stock market, started the day with lower prices on Tuesday. This happened because investors are worried about the future of companies that make computer chips, which are important for artificial intelligence (AI). A report about a Chinese company called DeepSeek making its own AI chip also made investors nervous. This is a big deal because many investors had been excited about the potential of AI to drive growth in the stock market, but now they're questioning whether that excitement is justified. The drop in the Nasdaq suggests that investors are taking a more cautious approach, at least for now.

originalTitle: NCDEX revives black pepper futures to boost India's price discovery
simplifiedContent: The National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange (NCDEX) has started offering black pepper futures again after a long time. This means that farmers, traders, and exporters can now use a regulated platform to manage the risks of buying and selling black pepper. The goal is to help India play a bigger role in deciding global black pepper prices. This is important because it can help these groups get fair prices and manage risks in a market where prices can change quickly. By doing this, NCDEX aims to make the market more stable and predictable for those involved in the black pepper trade.

originalTitle: PepsiCo and more: Jim Cramer says market rotation is creating buying chances, picks 4 stocks
simplifiedContent: A well-known investor, Jim Cramer, thinks that some good stocks have become cheaper to buy because of recent market changes. This happened because big investors sold some of their shares, which lowered the prices of quality stocks like PepsiCo, Starbucks, and a few others. Cramer believes this creates a good opportunity for individual investors to buy these stocks at a lower price. He specifically mentioned PepsiCo, Starbucks, Constellation Brands, TJX Companies, and Johnson & Johnson as potential good buys. This means that these stocks might be a good investment now, despite their recent price drop.

originalTitle: Wall Street: Nasdaq, S&P 500 slip as chip stocks decline
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the stock market news: The US stock market had a mixed day, meaning some parts did well and others did poorly. The Dow Jones, which is a group of big company stocks, went up a little bit (0.09%). However, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, which are also groups of company stocks, went down (0.28% and 0.62% respectively). This happened because stocks related to computer chips did poorly, which affected the overall performance of the S&P 500 and Nasdaq. This matters because it shows that the stock market can be unpredictable and different groups of stocks can perform differently on the same day.

originalTitle: Wipro to declare Q1FY27 results, interim dividend on this date. Check details
simplifiedContent: Wipro, a company listed on the stock market, will announce its financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year 2027 on July 16. The company's board of directors will meet on this date to review and approve these results. Additionally, they will consider paying an interim dividend to shareholders. Wipro's shares have been performing poorly, falling 34% in value so far this year, which may be a concern for investors. The upcoming announcement on July 16 may be important for investors to see if the company's financial results can help turn things around.

originalTitle: Penny stock under  ₹10 rallies for second straight session, jumps another 8%; here's why
simplifiedContent: A company called Golden Legend Leasing and Finance Ltd. saw its stock price go up by 8.3% to ₹9.46. This is the second day in a row that the stock price has increased. The company recently announced that it is starting a new subsidiary called Gullakkart Private Limited, which will help the company provide better digital financial services. This move likely caused the stock price to rise because it could lead to the company getting a special license from the RBI, which would allow it to offer more financial services. The increase in stock price is significant because it shows that investors are excited about the company's new plans and potential for growth.
